channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: This startup is helping brands show up in chatbots and AI search. Read the pitch deck it used to raise $4 million.
item.description: Azoma simulates how brands appear in chatbot replies and AI overviews, then creates content optimized for discovery by AI.

item.title: 5 shoe trends that are in this season and 4 that are out, according to stylists
item.description: Stylists say chunky boots and low-profile sneakers will be popular this winter. Logo-heavy and pointed-toe styles, however, won't be as prevalent.

item.title: The US will now review H-1B applicants' social media — and require them to make profiles public, State Department says
item.description: H-1B applicants and their dependents will face expanded online checks as the US tightens scrutiny of skilled-worker visas, a spokesperson said.

item.title: I stayed in a pod at an airport for $50. It was tiny and a bit awkward, but I slept surprisingly well between my flights.
item.description: To save money and sleep between flights, I spent $50 on a pod at the Bangkok airport's Avagard Capsule Hotel. I slept well and would book it again.

item.title: 1.1 million people have been laid off in the US this year — more than any year since the pandemic
item.description: 2025 has seen the most layoffs in the US since the pandemic, after over 70,000 jobs were cut in November, according to Challenger, Gray & Christmas.

item.title: Jensen Huang thinks AI is going to create one very wacky new job
item.description: Rather than costing jobs, Huang told Joe Rogan AI will create whole new industries, and jobs no one has ever thought of — like robot apparel maker.

item.title: Uber says one stat shows how much room the company has to grow in the US
item.description: Uber's market penetration and growth potential: CFO says 15% of US adults use its services, highlighting big opportunities in suburbs and delivery.

item.title: This AI startup generates content to help companies retain their customers. Read the pitch deck it used to raise $5 million.
item.description: Eikona wants to apply AI to A/B testing to disrupt the 'lifecycle marketing' industry. Here's the deck it used to raise $5 million.

item.title: I took a weeklong cruise and didn't check a bag. Here are 10 items I'm glad I packed and 9 things I wish I'd had with me.
item.description: I was glad I packed a magnet and the right shoes for my first cruise on a Royal Caribbean ship. Still, I longed for laundry soap and earplugs.

item.title: Spotify Wrapped is one of the best marketing strategies going. Good luck trying to replicate it.
item.description: Spotify Wrapped is back, but few companies can replicate its success.
